notes: Each settings/no-fit part's marks are counted ONCE, under its primary need (the first need in its 'need' string); 'also_secondary_in' lists parts where that need also appears. Strict reading: any mark the memo gives for writing an expression, equation, standard form, substitution or method (not a number) blocks 'fits'. Many no-fit parts still contain numeric answer marks (e.g. 1.1.2, 9.1, 10.2, 5.6) that num/steps could capture if partial banking were allowed. Five show-that parts (2.1.1, 3.2, 5.4, 10.1, 11.1.1 = 15 marks) cannot be marked by outcome at all because the answer is printed. Context is almost never the blocker: every figure is a graph/diagram image, two read-only tables (Q3, Q11.1), and the formula information sheet (must be reachable as a paper page). The one context gap is 4.5's blank axes for sketching. Paper PDF has no text layer (scanned); classification read from page images; memo read from its text layer + page images.
